verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama serving models to agents and launching third-party coding tools (ollama launch, OpenClaw integration). Nothing shows Ollama itself letting users configure automations, recurring schedules, or background tasks that run autonomously. OpenClaw and Claude Code are separate products Ollama connects to, so they are adjacent integrations and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
